第70章 阎王点卯-《我发现了世界BUG》

林舒的话音落下，他身上的那种“束缚感”瞬间就降低了许多。

或许正如他猜测的一样，“束缚”并不是阴山法的仪轨导致的，而是现实中存在的“人”导致的。

就好像在睡梦中如果尿湿了裤子会梦见掉进河里一样，在幻觉中，自己如果被人抱住了，显然也会产生束缚感。

这让林舒瞬间安心了很多----至少这证明，自己的队友们并没有完全失能，他们仍然在想办法。

只要他们在想办法，那就一定有办法！

斗法？

我跟你斗个毛！？

有什么比“直接摧毁”更有效的方法吗？

手里那么大一台国家机器不用，难道我还要跟你重新搭台唱戏？

可别闹了！

林舒静静等待，那些线条和黑雾仍然在缠绕、扭转。

但也就在某一个瞬间。

“嗡----”

仿佛有什么东西撕裂了空间。

巨大的、刺眼的光亮以无可匹敌的姿态吞没了那一团黑暗所在吗，无数条线条崩断，而连接在线条上的“黑雾”，则如同失去了依靠的泡沫一般，瞬间破碎。

林舒感觉，自己的世界眨了眨眼。

不是他眨眼。

而是整个世界，在他的面前缓缓刷新。

线条仍然存在，黑雾也仍然存在。

但有另一层“真实的图像”，叠加在了那层线条之上。

林舒看到了围绕在自己身边的人----不知在什么时候，秦朗带领的队伍已经回来了。

有人按着自己的肩膀，而自己则是坐在地上。

对面的山头上方飘着一团诡异的云雾----并不是像电影里面那种追求视觉效果的腾腾火焰，只是混杂着泥土、尘埃、白色硝烟的云团。

“炸了吗？”

“炸了......人工增雨......小当量......”

“还可以......要......再来？”

林舒看到秦朗的嘴巴张张合合，但他说出来的话，却是断断续续的。

准确地说，并不是他说的话断断续续，而是自己听到的声音断断续续。

那个最大的法坛很可能已经被摧毁了，自己在幻觉中面临的压力也已经降低了许多。

但它并没有直接消失。

“那边......那边......”

林舒伸手指向自己所看到的“黑雾浓郁处”所在的位置。

顺着他手指的方向，秦朗立刻回头，做出了简单的观察。

随后，他重新回过头来，把PDA举到了林舒面前。

那上面是一幅三维地图。

“这里？”

他在地图上标记了一个点位。

After Lin Shu finished speaking, the "sense of restraint" on his body instantly decreased a lot.

Perhaps as he guessed, the "bondage" was not caused by the rituals of Yinshan Dharma, but by the "people" existing in reality.

Just like if you wet your pants in your sleep and dream of falling into the river, in the hallucination, if you are hugged by someone, you will obviously feel restrained.

This made Lin Shu instantly feel relieved - at least it proved that his teammates were not completely disabled, and they were still thinking of a way.

As long as they are thinking of a way, there must be a way!

Fighting?

Let me fight with you!?

Is there any more effective method than "direct destruction"?

I don't need such a huge state machine in my hands, do I have to set up a new stage with you?

Stop it!

Lin Shu waited quietly, the lines and black mist were still twisting and twisting.

But just at a certain moment.

"Buzz----"

It was as if something was tearing apart the space.

The huge, dazzling light swallowed up the darkness in an unrivaled manner. Countless lines collapsed, and the "black mist" connected to the lines shattered instantly like a bubble that had lost its support.

Lin Shu felt that his world had blinked.

Not that he blinked.

Instead, the whole world slowly refreshed in front of him.

The lines are still there, the black fog is still there.

But there is another layer of "real image" superimposed on that layer of lines.

Lin Shu saw the people around him - at some point, the team led by Qin Lang had returned.

Someone was pressing his shoulders, while he was sitting on the ground.

There was a strange cloud floating above the mountain on the opposite side - not the soaring flames that pursue visual effects like those in movies, but a cloud mixed with mud, dust, and white gunpowder smoke.

"Did it explode?"

"It exploded...artificial rain...small yield..."

"Is it okay...want...to come again?"

Lin Shu saw Qin Lang's mouth opening and closing, but the words he spoke were intermittently.

To be precise, it was not that his words were broken, but that the voice he heard was broken.

The largest altar has probably been destroyed, and the pressure he faced in the hallucination has been reduced a lot.

But it doesn't just disappear.

"Over there...over there..."

Lin Shu stretched out his hand and pointed to the location of the "dense black mist" he saw.

Following the direction of his finger, Qin Lang immediately turned back and made a simple observation.

Then, he turned around again and raised the PDA in front of Lin Shu.

On top of that is a three-dimensional map.

"Here?"

He marked a point on the map.
